description: Flat record-level metadata schema for histological tissue samples stained with chemical dyes such as hematoxylin and eosin, capturing stain formulation, supplier and batch traceability, protocol parameters, modifications, and pathology-oriented context for reproducible morphology assessment.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record or staining event.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the tissue sample or specimen associated with this staining record.

slide_id.descr: Unique identifier for the histology slide on which the stain was applied, if applicable.

section_id.descr: Identifier for the tissue section or block-face section used for staining, if applicable.

specimen_type.descr: Type of specimen, e.g., biopsy, resection, autopsy tissue, organoid, or control tissue.

tissue_type.descr: Primary tissue or organ source, e.g., liver, lung, skin, colon.

anatomical_site.descr: More specific anatomical location of the sample, if known, e.g., distal colon, left lower lobe.

species.descr: Biological species of the specimen source, e.g., Homo sapiens, Mus musculus.

strain_or_line.descr: Strain, breed, or cell line designation if applicable.

sex.descr: Sex of the donor/source, if known; use controlled terms such as male, female, intersex, unknown.

age_value.descr: Age of the donor/source expressed as a numeric value when available.

age_unit.descr: Unit for age_value, e.g., years, months, days.

disease_state.descr: Disease or clinical state associated with the tissue, e.g., healthy, cancer, inflammation, fibrosis.

diagnosis_name.descr: Specific diagnosis or pathology label assigned to the specimen.

pathology_grade.descr: Pathology grade or severity score, if applicable.

fixation_method.descr: Fixation method used before staining, e.g., formalin, paraformaldehyde, frozen, or none.

fixative_name.descr: Exact fixative used, e.g., neutral buffered formalin.

decalcification_used.descr: Whether decalcification was performed before sectioning or staining.

embedding_medium.descr: Embedding medium used, e.g., paraffin, OCT, resin.

section_thickness_um.descr: Thickness of the tissue section in micrometers.

stain_method_name.descr: Name of the stain or staining method applied, e.g., hematoxylin and eosin, PAS, Masson's trichrome.

stain_component_name.descr: Name of an individual stain component or dye used in the protocol, if recording components separately.

stain_component_role.descr: Role of the stain component, e.g., nuclear stain, cytoplasmic stain, counterstain.

stain_class.descr: General stain category, e.g., routine histochemical, special stain, immunohistochemical, fluorescent.

stain_formulation_name.descr: Name of the specific formulation, recipe, or commercial formulation used.

stain_is_commercial.descr: Whether the stain or formulation was commercially purchased rather than prepared in-house.

stain_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer or supplier of the stain reagent or kit.

stain_catalog_number.descr: Catalog number or product code for the stain reagent or kit.

stain_lot_number.descr: Batch, lot, or serial number of the stain reagent or kit.

stain_expiration_date.descr: Expiration date of the stain reagent or kit.

stain_preparation_date.descr: Date on which the stain solution or working solution was prepared.

stain_concentration.descr: Concentration of the working stain solution; report in the chosen unit used by the laboratory, e.g., % w/v, mg/mL.

stain_concentration_unit.descr: Unit or expression for stain_concentration, e.g., %, mg/mL, mol/L.

stain_solvent.descr: Solvent or diluent used to prepare the stain, e.g., water, ethanol, buffered water.

stain_pH.descr: Measured pH of the stain solution, if relevant.

application_method.descr: How the stain was applied, e.g., immersion, automated stainer, manual dip, coplin jar.

staining_instrument.descr: Instrument, platform, or automated stainer used for the staining procedure, if applicable.

protocol_name.descr: Name or reference of the staining protocol used.

protocol_version.descr: Version or revision identifier for the staining protocol.

protocol_reference.descr: Citation, standard operating procedure identifier, or URL for the protocol used.

incubation_time_min.descr: Incubation or exposure time in minutes for the stain step.

incubation_temperature_c.descr: Incubation or staining temperature in degrees Celsius.

rinsing_solution.descr: Solution used for rinsing between staining steps, e.g., water, buffer, alcohol.

differentiation_used.descr: Whether a differentiation step was used in the staining protocol.

differentiation_reagent.descr: Reagent used for differentiation, if applicable.

bluing_step_used.descr: Whether a bluing step was used in the staining protocol.

bluing_reagent.descr: Reagent used for bluing, if applicable.

counterstain_name.descr: Name of the counterstain used, if applicable.

counterstain_duration_min.descr: Duration of counterstain exposure in minutes.

mounting_medium.descr: Mounting medium used after staining, if applicable.

dehydration_used.descr: Whether dehydration steps were performed after staining.

clearing_agent.descr: Clearing agent used after staining, e.g., xylene or substitute.

protocol_modification_used.descr: Whether any deviation or modification from the standard protocol was introduced.

protocol_modification_description.descr: Free-text description of changes to the standard protocol, including rationale if known.

operator_name.descr: Name or identifier of the person who performed the staining.

laboratory_name.descr: Laboratory, facility, or institution where staining was performed.

staining_date.descr: Date on which the staining procedure was performed.

staining_batch_id.descr: Identifier linking all samples stained together in the same run or batch.

control_sample_used.descr: Whether a positive, negative, or reference control tissue was included in the staining run.

control_sample_id.descr: Identifier of the control sample used, if applicable.

quality_assessment_result.descr: Overall quality assessment outcome for the stained slide, e.g., pass, fail, acceptable, poor.

quality_notes.descr: Free-text notes on staining quality, artifacts, uneven staining, or interpretive limitations.

analysis_purpose.descr: Intended use of the stain data, e.g., morphology assessment, pathology diagnosis, grading, biomarker context.

microscopy_modality.descr: Imaging or microscopy modality used for analysis, if applicable, e.g., brightfield, whole-slide scan.

scanner_model.descr: Scanner or microscope model used to digitize or inspect the slide, if applicable.

image_file_id.descr: Identifier of the associated image file or digital slide, if applicable.

analysis_date.descr: Date of downstream analysis or interpretation of the stained tissue, if applicable.

reviewer_name.descr: Name or identifier of the pathologist or analyst who reviewed the stained specimen.

review_result.descr: Interpretive result or summary from the review, e.g., normal morphology, dysplasia, malignant.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the stained specimen, protocol context, or interpretation.
